answer.text: The manual does not give a torque value for the front wheel spindle. It says only to tighten the spindle bolt firmly on the left-hand side.
The 25 Nm torque in the front wheel steps is for the fork clamp bolt, not the spindle.

watchouts.text: Make sure the front wheel is fitted correctly before you ride the motorcycle.
If the wheel is not fitted correctly, the motorcycle may not perform correctly, which may lead to an accident causing injury or loss of life.

watchout_review.reason: General reassembly caution; E36 and E37 cover the fitting risk.
Cited by the watchout on correct fitting before riding.
Cited by the watchout on the consequences of incorrect fitting.
